Craft rework 2026-10-07 (expression rework pass, lane 5; records re-read at fc59a719). The shared section-room grammar is retired; each scene now draws the record's own figure and the notation walks on it. m25 the QL unit mandala drawn (ground ring, stations ring, horizon ring); the eight determinations walk it in fixed order and the triangle opens to the square beside them. m26 the two triads drawn (emanative up, reversionary turned 180°) with the composed bridge between and the ring breathing over it; 4+2 → 5→0 → 4+2 walks above. m27 night ground: the drawn distinction circled, M → M(M)→U → re-entry walking, and the disc performing its re-entry from outside to inside the boundary. m28 the two charts squared with the overlap disc between; [1:0] reddened then made definite teal as the point itself crosses charts. m29 the torus as two interlocked rings on its covering square; T²/χ=0/(2,−1) and 16/9/9/8/2/1 walk the resolution; field held still from m28 (deliberate rest). m30 the atlas: three charts gathered inside the held field ring; lid → maker → arche-topos walks. Stillness pairs: m25–m26 (one paper, the pulse continuing), m28–m29 (one cold light, resolution read calmly). Colour arc: parchment → night → cold morning → gathering near-white. Stage text reduced to one hospitable line per room.

Deepen pass 2026-10-07 (second movement, lane 5; records re-read at fc59a719). DEPTH — movements 28 and 29 stand in 3d (view mode 3d, yaw 0.35 / pitch 0.22, field depth 0.55 authored as the volume of the space). In m28 the third dimension IS the representational space the record changes: the first chart lies in one plane (z −0.28), the second chart in another (z +0.2), and the blocked point [1:0] leaves the plane it breaks and lands in the plane that holds it — the handoff between charts is literally a change of plane, which is the record's own move (obstruction made tractable by changed representation). In m29 z is the lift: the covering square ℝ² lies below (z −0.3), the meridian and longitude rings stand above it (z 0.06) with the harmonic walk on them, and the T² walk rides the torus (z 0.4) — the path closes on the torus while its endpoints stay apart on the plane below; the third dimension is the retained difference the record proves (local closure and retained displacement coexist exactly). ALIVE — one shared morph clock on m28–m29: engine.morphEnabled with trajectory toroidalHopf and sine drive; morph law theta at thetaRate 0.16 / phiRate 0.09 — the two rates are the torus's two independent windings, so the field itself circulates the record's π₁(T²)=ℤ×ℤ while the drawn figures hold. Four physics profiles across the journey (particle props vary across states, hold within rests): parchment print (m25–m26, grain 0.035, halo 0.13, opacity 0.92, roundness 0.95, softness 0.15, irregularity 0.35, elongation 0.04, contrast 0.93); night ink bloom (m27: grain 0.05, halo 0.22, opacity 0.85, roundness 0.8, softness 0.3, irregularity 0.5, elongation 0.08, contrast 0.88 — the mark's ink breathes on the dark); cold streaked light (m28–m29 shared: grain 0.02, halo 0.09, opacity 0.94, roundness 0.9, softness 0.12, irregularity 0.28, elongation 0.16, contrast 0.97 — the elongation carries the walk's direction); gathered soft light (m30: grain 0.05, halo 0.3, opacity 0.8, roundness 0.7, softness 0.22, irregularity 0.6, contrast 0.85, depth 0.2). TITLES — every scene title is the record's own line: m25 'The ground–mark relation unfolds as eight determinations' (thesis), m26 'The native generative kernel of QL', m27 'The mark creates inside and outside together', m28 'Obstructions become tractable after the representational space is changed', m29 'Local closure and retained displacement coexist exactly' (the record's bold claim), m30 'No single chart covers the whole' (the atlas paragraph). STEP-SCALE — no text-changing step carries objectState.size: where the walker's glyph changes, the step animates position only (objectState omitted; the engine auto-fits each glyph), and the ink-deepening and reddened-switch tints of the craft pass are carried by the drawn figures instead (the red ground ring stands at the mandala's centre for the return-switch; the blocked-point disc performs [1:0]'s red-to-teal crossing). Same-text steps of non-text formations keep complete objectStates (the breathed ring's pulse, the re-entering disc, the crossing point).
